styleSelection.reason: Sargent builds the ship from confident wet-on-dry value planes over a soft first wash; pure watercolour, structure from shaped paint, dark paint accents and reserved paper, no ink

families.referenceCue: white bow in cool blue-grey; pale foundation on dry paper, greys variegated by the painter's own soft merges; cream light streaks left as paper; hard dark-blue left edge, crisp right edge, orange rivet dots and dark hawse hole on dry paper
cream paper with loose pale cobalt strokes; tan and grey rigging diagonals, dark round blocks and the orange spar painted crisp on dry paper
sea under a firm horizon: yellow-green near the horizon grading to teal, broken lighter ripples
vertical orange and grey masts and a diagonal spar against pale blue; crisp narrow strokes
blue hull of the boat behind with white streaks; ochre anchor with orange shank, hard edges against the blue
dark mixed foreground of browns and blues under the bow; darkest shadow at the hull foot
